capabilities: Convert between Markdown outlines and mind maps
extras: Works on mobile devices via a floating panel. Maps are standard Excalidraw elements, maintaining full Excalidraw functionality.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin that adds XMind-style mind map editing to Excalidraw drawings.
problem: Users need a way to create and manage complex, hierarchical mind maps within the visual environment of Excalidraw using familiar keyboard shortcuts.
summary: Adds XMind-style mind map editing capabilities to Excalidraw drawings, allowing keyboard-first creation and manipulation of complex hierarchical structures.
